notes.title: Major update!
notes.notes:
1. "The visual novel has received a major update with full English localization - now featuring both enhanced literary text and full voice acting! You can switch between them anytime and mix-n-match your preferred subtitles with audio."

2. "We've added a brand new achievement tree! With 50 diverse and challenging achievements to unlock. You'll need to bring your A-game to collect them all!"

3. "Oh, and we've rebalanced everyone's favorite companion - Rakhnov. ;)"

notes.title: First Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Edits have been made for large-format screens
- Added the ability to skip some cutscenes
- - Fixed a bug that caused the cutscene to freeze with a white screen on some devices 
- Edits have been made to the text of the dialogues 
- Added visual language change enhancement

notes.title: We are participating in the demo festival! And March 4 is the release!
notes.notes:
We are taking part in the "Games to Be" festival with a new demo version! Support us by playing the game and telling your friends. And on March 4, we're fully releasing! :)
